title: A|E Slot-Occupancy Law and Role-Symmetry Audit

collision_resolution.reason: 040 is already occupied by an applied fixed-point semantics patch.
collision_resolution.resolution: Renumber proposed A|E nesting audit to PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_046.

basis.scope: Introduce a governed A|E slot-occupancy and role-symmetry audit for completed RT expressions under explicit role typing and domain rebinding. This patch records candidate occupancy and swap-check boundaries without asserting universal symmetry, universal occupancy, recovery, or any RT_core change.

core_rule.statement: Completed RT expressions may be considered candidate occupants of A-slot or E-slot only after explicit role typing and domain rebinding into the receiving domain; swap checks remain required before any symmetry conclusion, and RT_core remains unchanged.

required_repo_changes.change: Add a content-filled operational witness instantiating C_A, C_E, normalization, RT closure, rebinding, A/E slot occupancy, and candidate nested RT formation from an existing basin/projection case.
Add a stepwise admissibility trace showing why completed RT occupants become A/E slot candidates only after explicit domain rebinding.
Add a local swap test for the selected basin/projection witness and record whether admissibility changes under swapped roles.

success_criteria: The operational witness uses existing basin/projection content rather than a newly invented domain.
The admissibility trace distinguishes continuation declaration, normalization, RT closure, domain rebinding, slot typing, and candidate nesting.
The swap test evaluates the swapped construction independently and records a bounded local result.
PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_046 remains PROPOSED unless the governance gate accepts promotion.
No textbook surface is updated by this execution-surface pass.
purpose: Introduce an explicit governed audit surface for whether completed RT expressions may occupy A-slots and E-slots inside another A|E admissibility window.

standing_corrections.RT: RT is a closure condition, not a primitive rank.
standing_corrections.primitive_rule: Primitive(x) -> RT(x); RT(x) does not imply Primitive(x).
standing_corrections.A_E_current_status: A|E is currently governed as a whole-expression primitive affect/effect distinction condition, with D(*|*) as projection.
standing_corrections.operator_family: <*>_x is a typed meta-relation / composition schema, not a proof operator.

slot_occupancy_law.statement: A completed RT expression may be considered as a candidate occupant of an A-slot or E-slot only after explicit role typing and domain rebinding.

role_symmetry_statement.statement: A-slot and E-slot occupancy are not presumed symmetric. Symmetry, asymmetry, or conditional symmetry must be established by admissibility checks.

ae_nesting_constraint.statement: <A|E>_r is not a governed <*>_x instance until its A-role, E-role, substrate/scale, residue parameter, and closure condition are explicitly typed.

explicit_non_claims: This patch does not assert that completed RTs already occupy A/E slots.
This patch does not assert role symmetry.
This patch does not modify RT_core.
This patch does not promote <A|E>_r to theorem status.
This patch does not identify OPEN_BRIDGE_001 closure with basin closure.
This patch does not treat Memory Tensor metaphor as mechanism-level proof.

required_audit_checks.description: Define candidate A-slot occupancy requirements for a completed RT expression.
Define candidate E-slot occupancy requirements for a completed RT expression.
Compare A-slot and E-slot requirements for symmetry, asymmetry, or conditional symmetry.
Specify whether residue parameter r preserves, breaks, or records role asymmetry.
Produce one worked nesting example before textbook promotion.

premises: Let CompletedRT_A := NF(C_A) and CompletedRT_E := NF(C_E) be completed RT expressions.
Let x declare the shared nesting domain.
Let S denote the shared substrate/scale; S is continuous substrate, not a third endpoint.
Let r record residue/history for the enclosing window.
worked_nesting_example.rebinding_note: Both occupants are considered only after explicit role typing and domain rebinding into x.
worked_nesting_example.audit_reading: This is a candidate witness for slot occupancy, not a theorem. It shows that one completed RT may be placed in each slot of the same window only under explicit typing; it does not prove symmetry, universal occupancy, or admissibility in all contexts.
worked_nesting_example.swap_observation: Swapping CompletedRT_A and CompletedRT_E must be checked separately; if admissibility changes, the roles are not symmetric.
